lines: Built with: no bundler config in /app, package.json declares no bundler.
No node_modules in /app, so neither the framework the delivered packages are written against nor their installed versions are known. 1 package is delivered.

96 delivered files carry no source map, 9 files do. The bytes of the unmapped ones are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: a copy of a file of the checkout, the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.

7 delivered files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file and the chunk figures below say nothing about what is inside them.
No src directory in /app, so no finding about how this app imports anything could be made. --src=DIR names the source directory.
